earnings.title: Air Products Reports Fiscal 2026 Full-Year and Fourth Quarter Results; Provides Fiscal 2027 Guidance
highlights: GAAP earnings per share ("EPS") # of $2.39 and operating income of $23 million (compared to loss per share of $1.74 and operating loss of $877 million in the prior year); both periods reflect significant charges related to project exits
GAAP EPS # of $2.62 and operating income of $633 million reflect the impact of project exits, primarily related to two China coal gasification plants
Adjusted EPS * of $13.45 increased 12 percent over the prior year and also benefited from higher equity affiliates' income.
On a non-GAAP basis, fourth quarter adjusted operating income * of $856 million increased five percent on higher volumes and pricing actions, partially offset by higher costs.
Reduced capital spend relative to prior year | Expanded backlog, including over $2.0 billion of new electronics wins
outlook: Adjusted earnings per share * of $13.45 increased 12 percent and exceeded guidance midpoint; adjusted operating income * of $3.2 billion increased 11 percent
Adjusted EPS * of $3.61 exceeded guidance midpoint; adjusted operating income * of $856 million
Fiscal 2027 full-year adjusted EPS guidance * of $14.15 to $14.50; fiscal 2027 first quarter adjusted EPS guidance * of $3.35 to $3.45
Expect fiscal year 2027 capital expenditures * in the range of $3.0 billion to $3.5 billion
